label: Payment processing failures
title: Payment processing failing
description: Payment processing is failing for multiple customers. Transactions are timing out, and several customers have reported duplicate payment attempts. The issue started approximately 15 minutes ago.

label: Slow logins after a release
title: Login latency after release
description: Since this morning's release, login requests take 8-12 seconds for some users. Most logins eventually succeed. Auth service CPU is around 70% and support has received a handful of complaints.

label: Primary database unreachable
title: Orders database unreachable
description: The primary orders database stopped accepting connections at 02:14 UTC. The application returns 500 errors on every order page and the replica shows increasing replication lag.

label: Memory growth in a worker
title: Worker memory leak
description: The report generation worker memory climbs steadily and the pods are restarted by the orchestrator roughly every two hours. Reports are delayed but eventually complete.

label: Cosmetic UI issue
title: Misaligned footer link
description: There is a minor alignment issue with the footer links on the pricing page on small screens, and a typo in the 'Contact us' text. No functionality is affected.
